about: What this member said on the floor, from the Congressional Record: their own words only, and of those the sentences that name an alignment question's phrases or make a commitment. Written by npm run record:collect (scripts/collect-record.mjs).
name: John Boozman

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: FARM BILL
statements.title: FARM BILL
sentences: Hard-working farmers and ranchers are struggling to break even, let alone profit, in this current economic climate.
That is why we took urgent action last year to update farm programs in the Working Families Tax Cut.
The Working Families Tax Cut enhances commodity programs, expands access to more affordable crop insurance, and makes those tools more responsive to real-world risk.

It strengthens local economies, improves quality of life, and delivers critical infrastructure and services from safe and reliable drinking water to expanded broadband access, medical care, and affordable childcare--helping families thrive and supporting growth in our rural communities.

I urge my colleagues to join me in sending a clear message to rural America: The Senate stands with our farm families, and we are committed to ensuring they have the certainty, the tools, and the support they need to succeed.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: LEGISLATIVE SESSION
statements.title: LEGISLATIVE SESSION
sentences: The VA reports that veterans who contact VCL are 10 times more likely to receive mental health care than those who do not.
I support this amendment and urge its adoption and would be glad to scream out ``yes'' with a voice vote.
Vote on Amendment No. 3432 Mr. President, veterans who are found by competent judicial authority to be a danger to themselves or others are reported to NICS under current law.

Under the terms of current law with this amendment in place, veterans who are found to be a danger to themselves or others by a judge, magistrate, or other judicial authority are reported to the NICS system, as is entirely appropriate.
For this reason, I urge a ``no'' vote.
